//: The Form Studio Excel template. One source for the template generator and the browser reader (src/intake/excel/read-excel.ts). Column ideas from formgen's sheet; no formgen code.

about.help: What the form is called in the EMR. Must not match another form unless you are replacing it.
One of the project encounter types (e.g. Consultation, Triage, Vitals). Leave blank to choose in Form Studio.
18-40 words: what the form records, for whom, when.
Only when this rebuilds a form that already ships: its identity (uuid, name, encounter) is kept.

columns.help: Page title. Blank = same page as the row above (the first page defaults to '<Form name> Assessment').
Section title. Blank = same section as the row above.

Optional. Rows next to each other with the same Group name are saved together (an O3 obsGroup), e.g. Blood pressure: systolic + diastolic. Put yes in Repeat on any of them and the whole group gets an "Add" button.
The question as the clinician reads it.
Optional short id (letters/digits, no spaces). Blank = made from the question. Needed when another row's 'Show if' points here.
text, long text, number, date, date-time, time, yes/no, one of, many of, dropdown, calculated, note.
For one of / many of / dropdown: answers separated by ; (e.g. Supine; Sitting), or the name of a list on the Options sheet.
Optional: the concept uuid or exact concept name. Blank = Form Studio searches the dictionary by the question.
Optional, for a Group: an existing SET concept (uuid or exact name). Blank = Form Studio searches by the group name. Never a new concept.
yes = must be filled.
Numbers: lowest allowed value.
Numbers: highest allowed value.
yes = no decimals.
Shown after the label, e.g. mmHg, kg, cm.
Numbers: a yellow warning (does not block saving) below this value.
Numbers: a yellow warning above this value.
Dates: blank or no = past and today only.
Show only when: <Question ID> = <option>, <Question ID> has <option> (many of), <Question ID> is answered, age > 5, sex = F.
For calculated: BMI(<height id>, <weight id>), EDD(<LNMP id>), or an engine expression. Shown read-only.
yes on a row inside a Group = the group can be entered more than once (repeating group). On a row without a Group it is only flagged (a single question can't repeat in O3).
yes = already in the patient record (name, MRN, age, sex): not built into the form, listed for review.
Anything for the reviewer. Not built into the form.

optionColumns.help: The name used in the Questions sheet's Options column.
Optional concept uuid or exact name for this answer.
